title: External-effect intent record (CANDIDATE v1)
description: One record per external side effect (WisprStudio export commit, Klaint connector mutation; WisprSide text delivery is recorded as a delivery_outcome instead). States and transitions are copied from TheHalfMoon/Orcel@f0b78e6544cf6ea9c2457a6b6f483490c7bd0f6f crates/orcel-journal/src/lib.rs IntentState::may_become (see transitions/effect_intent.json). An interrupted dispatched intent is 'unknown' and is closed only by a reconcile probe, never by blind retry. The referenced verdict must match the intent's action class and principal and have enforced_decision ALLOW (runtime check).

idempotency_key.description: Klaint: H(tenant, conversation, tool, canonical arguments) so a customer double-send or a superseded turn maps to the same key. Unique per (principal_scope_ref, owner, idempotency_key); dispatch is refused while a non-terminal intent with the same key exists (runtime check).

reconcile_probe.description: Read-only probe that decides an unknown outcome, for example a connector GET by idempotency key.

detail_ref.description: Optional pointer to the product record that details the effect (for example the Studio export record).
